houseRules.metadataDescription: Review the house rules for Sea Key Property, including check-in times, visitor policy, apartment care, cleaning, laundry, and safety guidance.
houseRules.intro: Welcome. We hope you have a comfortable and enjoyable stay. Please note that these are self-catering apartments, so hotel services are not provided.
rules: Check-in and Check-out
Check-in starts from 2:00 PM. Check-out is before 12:00 PM noon.
Visitors, Parties, and Events
Visitors are not permitted. Parties and events are not allowed.
Pets
Pets are not allowed inside the apartment.
Bed Linen Care
Please do not decorate the bed linen with flowers, as this may cause permanent stains.
Smoking
Smoking is permitted only in designated areas. Please dispose of cigarette butts responsibly.
Quiet Hours
Please respect your neighbours by keeping noise to a minimum, especially during the evening and night.
Apartment and Resort Care
Treat the apartment and resort with the same care and respect as you would your own home.
Air Conditioning
Please switch off the air conditioning whenever you leave the apartment.
Damage or Breakages
If anything is damaged or broken during your stay, please inform us immediately so we can arrange repairs.
Clean Floors
Please do not throw food on the floor.
Rubbish Disposal
For rubbish disposal, please use the garbage collection tube located on the wall behind the elevator.
Children
Children must be supervised by their parents or guardians at all times.
Conserve Utilities
Please help us conserve water and electricity.
Bathroom Use
Do not flush toilet paper or other items down the toilet. Please use the waste bin provided.
paidServices: Laundry service is available for an additional charge.
Apartment cleaning, including fresh bed linen and towels, is available for an additional charge.
houseRules.serviceBody: For laundry or apartment cleaning requests, contact our team.
houseRules.thankYou: Thank you for respecting these house rules. We appreciate your cooperation and wish you a pleasant stay.

privacyPolicy.metadataDescription: Learn how Sea Key Property collects, protects, and handles your personal information for apartment reservations, resort security, and guest services.
privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro: At Sea Key Property, we respect your privacy and are committed to safeguarding your personal data. This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect guest information in connection with our self-catering rental apartments, house rules compliance, and hospitality services.
card1Items: Full name, email address, phone number, and number of guests for reservation confirmations.
Passport or national ID copies required upon arrival to comply with Egyptian Tourism Authority rules and resort gate access.
Transaction IDs and payment confirmation timestamps. We do not store raw credit card numbers.
card2Items: Scheduling check-in (from 2:00 PM), check-out (before 12:00 PM), and key handovers.
Providing arrival instructions, apartment access codes, and assistance during your stay.
Arranging optional airport transfers, on-demand laundry, or extra apartment cleaning upon request.
privacyPolicy.card3Body: In accordance with our property house rules, only registered guests are permitted inside the apartments. Guest identification records ensure compliance with resort safety protocols, prevent unauthorized visitors or parties, and guarantee a peaceful community environment for all neighbors.
privacyPolicy.card4Body: We retain booking information only for as long as necessary to complete your stay and satisfy local legal or tax obligations. We never sell or rent your personal information to third parties. Data is shared exclusively with secure payment processors (e.g. PayPal) and official resort compound security.
privacyPolicy.rightsBody: You have the right to review, update, or request the deletion of your personal records following your departure, provided all outstanding balances and property inspections are settled. To request data updates or ask any questions regarding our privacy practices, please contact our local hosting team directly.
privacyPolicy.supportBody: Have questions or need assistance with your personal information or resort check-in requirements?

refundPolicy.metadataDescription: Read the refund policy for Sea Key Property, covering eligible refund scenarios, check-out inspections, deposit return timelines, and non-refundable items.
refundPolicy.title: Refund Policy
refundPolicy.intro: At Sea Key Property, we are committed to clear and fair terms. Because our properties are self-catering holiday homes held exclusively for your reserved dates, refunds are governed by the guidelines below.
card1Items: Full or partial refunds issued in accordance with our Cancellation Policy timelines (14+ days for full refund, 7–13 days for 50%).
If a property experiences major plumbing, electrical, or structural failures that cannot be repaired promptly, guests are refunded in full.
Reconciled immediately upon identification with the payment gateway.
refundPolicy.card2Intro: During check-out (before 12:00 PM noon), our local team inspects the apartment to ensure compliance with House Rules. The following damages will result in deductions from the security deposit:
card2Deductions: Permanent stains on bed linens (e.g. from flower decorations or spilled oils).
Broken appliances, air conditioners, furniture, or fixtures.
Lost apartment keys or resort security gate passes.
Deep cleaning costs required due to smoking indoors or trash neglect.
card3Items: Completed accommodation days and past dates are non-refundable.
Rendered laundry services, executed airport transfers, and completed cleaning requests are non-refundable once delivered.
Bookings terminated on-site due to unauthorized parties, illegal visitors, or pet violations do not qualify for any refund.
refundPolicy.card4Body: Approved refunds are processed through the original payment method used during booking (PayPal account or bank card). Once initiated by our administrative team, funds typically appear in your account within 5 to 10 business days, depending on your bank or payment provider's settlement schedule.
refundPolicy.guaranteeBody: Should an accidental breakage or issue occur during your holiday, please notify our team immediately so we can resolve it together transparently and avoid surprises during check-out inspection.
refundPolicy.supportBody: If you have questions regarding a pending refund, deposit return, or an inspection report, please reach out directly.

cancellationPolicy.metadataDescription: Understand cancellation terms for Sea Key Property, including refund windows, date modifications, house rules compliance, and host cancellation guarantees.
cancellationPolicy.title: Cancellation Policy
cancellationPolicy.intro: We understand that travel plans can change. To keep our self-catering holiday apartments available and well-prepared for all guests, our cancellations and date modifications follow the terms detailed below.
card1Items: Cancellations made at least 14 days before the scheduled check-in date (2:00 PM) are eligible for a full refund of the deposit paid.
Cancellations made between 7 and 13 days prior are eligible for a 50% refund of the deposit.
Cancellations made within 7 days of arrival or failure to check in without notice are non-refundable.
cancellationPolicy.card2Intro: Guests agree to respect our official House Rules upon booking. Immediate reservation cancellation without refund applies if a guest commits serious breaches during their stay, including:
card2Breaches: Hosting unauthorized visitors, parties, or social gatherings.
Bringing pets into the apartment without prior permission.
Causing deliberate disturbance during night quiet hours.
cancellationPolicy.card3Body: Official check-out is before 12:00 PM noon on your departure date. If you decide to vacate the apartment earlier than your booked departure date, unused nights are non-refundable, as the apartment was reserved and held exclusively for your booking calendar.
cancellationPolicy.card4Body: Requests to adjust your arrival or departure dates can be accommodated free of charge when submitted at least 7 days prior to check-in, subject to apartment availability and seasonal rate differences. Please reach out to our hosting team as early as possible to adjust dates.
cancellationPolicy.guaranteeBody: In the rare event of an unforeseen maintenance issue or unforeseen circumstance rendering the property unfit for stay, our team will immediately offer you an upgraded alternative accommodation or issue a 100% full refund of all sums paid.
cancellationPolicy.supportBody: Contact our local host care team with your booking number to process your cancellation or modification request.
